title: Invasion Landing Defenders
description: While assigning ground forces to planets, each planet card in the landing tray now lists the other players' units on it: owner, ground forces by type (damaged mechs called out), PDS, and other structures such as space docks as secondary info, plus the Space Cannon Defense those units roll against forces landed there (dice, hit values from the defender's faction and researched technologies, expected hits), or that it is silenced by the invader's L4 Disruptors. Synthetic fixtures, not captured engine states. Regenerate with npm run screenshots -- CM.

shots.heading: Three planets, desktop
shots.caption: Moll: Hacan with 1 mech, 3 infantry, 1 PDS and a space dock; Space Cannon Defense 1 die hitting on 6. Jord has no defenders (no block). Quann: only a PDS, so no ground forces but still Space Cannon Defense.

shots.heading: Three planets, 390x844
shots.caption: Same on a phone: the defender line wraps inside the card, no horizontal scroll.

shots.heading: PDS II and a damaged mech, desktop
shots.caption: The defender has PDS II researched: 2 PDS roll 2 dice hitting on 5, about 1.2 hits expected. The damaged mech is marked.

shots.heading: PDS II and a damaged mech, 390x844
shots.caption: Same on a phone.

shots.heading: L4 Disruptors, desktop
shots.caption: The invader owns L4 Disruptors, so the PDS is listed but Space Cannon Defense is shown as silenced (greyed).

notes.title: Data
notes.text: Everything comes from the board view the client already has (units with a planet in board.systems[system].units) and the content catalog for unit values (resolveUnit for the owner's faction and public technologies). No engine change; nothing added to canonical() or the fingerprint.

notes.title: Not modelled
notes.text: Plasma Scoring's extra die, Disable, Quietus, Entropic Scars and other card or faction modifiers the engine applies when Space Cannon Defense actually fires.
